  "guidance": "Recompute and reconcile all core metrics with a single, auditable set of standard assumptions: use capex_per_kw = capex_per_kWh × median_duration_hours (or clearly justify a different method and document it). Correct any numeric inconsistencies in the artifact (e.g., Li-ion capex_per_kw value and its relation to capex_per_kWh; ensure sensitivity results move in the expected directions). Generate and attach a cost-vs-duration scatter (as an image file) and reference it in the CSV or accompanying text. Ensure the CSV fields exactly match technology, median_capex_usd_per_kwh, median_capex_usd_per_kw, median_duration_hours, median_efficiency_pct, median_lcoc_usd_per_kwh, capex_range_usd_per_kwh, notes_assumptions, source_summary, summary_paragraph, and include a clean numeric summary paragraph. Save a corrected cost_duration_analysis.csv and the accompanying chart, and provide a concise numeric executive briefing reflecting the corrected numbers."
